definitions.explanation: A substance added to soil to supply nutrients that promote plant growth, including both organic and chemical types.

examples.japanese: ⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{肥料|ひりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まく→撒く：12711_maku⟧。
examples.english: To spread fertilizer on the field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有機|ゆうき}→有機：03643_yuuki⟧{肥料|ひりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: To grow vegetables using organic fertilizer.

examples.japanese: {肥料|ひりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{与|あた}えすぎ→与える：01821_ataeru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
USAGE:
{肥料|ひりょう} is the general term for fertilizer. In gardening and agriculture, choosing the right type is important for plant health.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {肥料|ひりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まく→撒く：12711_maku⟧/⟦{施|ほどこ}す→施す：12985_hodokosu⟧ (spread/apply fertilizer)
- {肥料|ひりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧ (give fertilizer)

TYPES OF FERTILIZER:
- ⟦{有機|ゆうき}→有機：03643_yuuki⟧{肥料|ひりょう} (organic fertilizer)
- ⟦{化学|かがく}→化学：05336_kagaku_chem⟧{肥料|ひりょう}/⟦{化成|かせい}→化成：noentry⟧{肥料|ひりょう} (chemical fertilizer)
- ⟦{堆肥|たいひ}→堆肥：06471_taihi⟧ (compost)
- ⟦{液体|えきたい}→液体：04134_ekitai⟧{肥料|ひりょう}/⟦{液肥|えきひ}→液肥：26357_ekihi⟧ (liquid fertilizer)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{施肥|せひ}→施肥：26188_sehi⟧ (fertilization - the act)
- ⟦{追肥|ついひ}→追肥：08232_tsuihi⟧ (additional fertilizing)
- ⟦{元肥|もとごえ}→元肥：26356_motogoe⟧ (base fertilizer)
